founder.title: Founder
founder.name: Fernando Camacho Ospina
founder.credentials: PhD, Biomedical Engineering — University of New South Wales, Sydney · Master of Biomedical Engineering — UNSW
founder.tagline: Researcher at the intersection of biomedical engineering, applied statistics, behavioral science, and artistic philosophy.
founder.bio: Fernando Camacho Ospina holds a PhD in Biomedical Engineering from the University of New South Wales (Sydney, Australia) and a Master of Biomedical Engineering from the same institution. His 30-year career spans academic research, medical technology, applied neuroscience, education analytics, and enterprise consulting — across Colombia, Australia, and internationally. His doctoral research developed advanced statistical and signal processing methods for cardiovascular physiology, establishing the rigorous quantitative approach to human systems that underpins all his subsequent work. He has taught at Universidad de los Andes and Universidad de la Sabana, published in peer-reviewed journals including Physiological Measurement and Global Business Review, and led enterprise projects applying neuroscience and behavioral science to real organisational challenges — including an applied neuroscience marketing venture, a university-level education analytics platform, and a large-scale live-class restructuring that achieved a 30% cost reduction at a leading online education company. The PeopleArt methodology emerged from a pattern observed across all these domains: mastery — in science, sport, music, or enterprise — follows identifiable principles. Fernando holds Colombian and Australian nationalities and is fluent in Spanish, English, and German.
